exposure: fetal heart beat before intervention (bradycardia, tachycardia)
cohort: The study included 270 mothers who gave birth through emergency cesarean section at Wolkite University specialized hospital.
finding: The prevalence of low 5th minute Apgar score was 27.4%, and significant predictors included fetal bradycardia or tachycardia before intervention, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, labor duration greater than 24 hours, and low birth weight.
